<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="26" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">8:23</text>
    <rect x="308" y="15" width="4" height="10" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="314" y="12" width="4" height="13" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="320" y="9" width="4" height="16" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="326" y="6" width="4" height="19" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <circle cx="339" cy="16" r="4" fill="#000000"/>
    <circle cx="347" cy="16" r="4" fill="#000000"/>
    <line x1="343" y1="12" x2="343" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <line x1="335" y1="16" x2="335" y2="16" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <rect x="355" y="9" width="22" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <rect x="377" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="357" y="11" width="15" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Main onboarding content -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="62" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#4F67C9">Skip</text>
    <text x="24" y="106" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="800" fill="#363A50">Know the best time</text>
    <text x="24" y="136" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="800" fill="#363A50">to buy your trip</text>
    <text x="24" y="172" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#383A4D">Track flights and get notified when prices change for your trip.</text>
    <text x="24" y="192" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#383A4D">Save when the fare drops and book with confidence.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Illustration -->
  <g>
    <rect x="53" y="220" width="284" height="246" rx="28" fill="#F3F2F0"/>
    <circle cx="91" cy="282" r="28" fill="#B6C2EE"/>
    <circle cx="262" cy="268" r="17" fill="#475FC7"/>
    <circle cx="299" cy="300" r="12" fill="#F5E070"/>
    <rect x="87" y="340" width="145" height="74" rx="14" fill="#1B1D38"/>
    <rect x="110" y="258" width="92" height="28" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="121" y="268" width="54" height="8" rx="4" fill="#EFECE9"/>
    <rect x="121" y="280" width="38" height="8" rx="4" fill="#EFECE9"/>
    
    <!-- airplane -->
    <path d="M233 286 L274 271 L281 276 L246 296 L232 300 L221 294 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <path d="M242 289 L257 302 L251 305 L236 294 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <path d="M229 288 L219 281 L224 278 L236 284 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- chart -->
    <rect x="75" y="365" width="188" height="82" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.96"/>
    <line x1="87" y1="434" x2="250" y2="434" stroke="#DCDCDA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="87" y1="419" x2="250" y2="419" stroke="#ECEBE8" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="87" y1="404" x2="250" y2="404" stroke="#ECEBE8" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polyline points="92,424 118,414 142,420 166,390 189,398 212,374 240,385" fill="none" stroke="#4761C8" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <circle cx="118" cy="414" r="4" fill="#4761C8"/>
    <circle cx="166" cy="390" r="4" fill="#4761C8"/>
    <circle cx="212" cy="374" r="4" fill="#4761C8"/>
    <rect x="87" y="377" width="38" height="18" rx="9" fill="#416D65"/>
    <text x="96" y="389" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">$238</text>
    <rect x="194" y="349" width="64" height="18" rx="9" fill="#F5E070"/>
    <text x="202" y="361" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#161C35">Price drop</text>
    <circle cx="236" cy="311" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="247" cy="303" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="258" cy="310" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="236" y1="311" x2="247" y2="303" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="247" y1="303" x2="258" y2="310" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    
    <!-- small travel notification cards -->
    <rect x="203" y="392" width="118" height="46" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="214" y="409" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#525467">Fare alert</text>
    <text x="214" y="423" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">San Diego to Tokyo</text>
    <text x="281" y="423" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#4761C8">$238</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Progress dots -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="181" cy="520" r="5" fill="#363A50"/>
    <circle cx="196" cy="520" r="5" fill="#7B7D85"/>
    <circle cx="211" cy="520" r="5" fill="#7B7D85"/>
    <circle cx="226" cy="520" r="5" fill="#7B7D85"/>
  </g>

  <!-- CTA button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="31" y="556" width="328" height="48" rx="8" fill="#4F67C9"/>
    <text x="195" y="587" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Let’s go</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Supporting cards -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="650" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#161C35">How price tracking works</text>
    <text x="291" y="650" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#4F67C9">See all</text>

    <rect x="24" y="664" width="342" height="84" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="25.5" y="665.5" width="342" height="84" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <circle cx="54" cy="706" r="20" fill="#EAF0FF"/>
    <polyline points="46,706 52,712 62,698" fill="none" stroke="#4F67C9" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="86" y="692" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#161C35">Watch a route</text>
    <text x="86" y="712" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">Follow flights from New York to Paris and get alerted when prices change.</text>
    <text x="86" y="731" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#4F67C9">Average savings: $84</text>

    <rect x="24" y="758" width="342" height="58" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="25.5" y="759.5" width="342" height="58" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>
    <circle cx="54" cy="787" r="18" fill="#F5E070"/>
    <text x="49" y="792" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#161C35">$</text>
    <text x="86" y="779" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#161C35">Book at the right moment</text>
    <text x="86" y="799" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">We’ll tell you when a trip hits your target price.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="784" width="390" height="60" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="0" y="784" width="390" height="1" fill="#D9D9D9"/>

    <g transform="translate(26,795)">
      <rect x="6" y="4" width="12" height="10" fill="none" stroke="#4F67C9" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="0,10 12,0 24,10" fill="none" stroke="#4F67C9" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="12" y="31" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#4F67C9">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(108,795)">
      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="17" y1="17" x2="22" y2="22" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="12" y="31" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#525467">Search</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(184,795)">
      <rect x="4" y="5" width="16" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="7" y1="1" x2="7" y2="9" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="17" y1="1" x2="17" y2="9" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="4" y1="10" x2="20" y2="10" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="12" y="31" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#525467">Trips</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(260,795)">
      <circle cx="12" cy="9" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="6" y="14" width="12" height="10" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="12" y="31" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#525467">Deals</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(336,795)">
      <circle cx="12" cy="9" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="6" y="14" width="12" height="10" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="12" y="31" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#525467">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- subtle divider accents -->
  <line x1="24" y1="632" x2="366" y2="632" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="24" y1="748" x2="366" y2="748" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
</svg>
